rv.q: Craig (Ross Allan), Donny (Stephen Docherty) and Jay (Craig McLean) are an unlikely trio. The three bond at a meeting for people with addictions and start spending more time together. Donny is an alcoholic and when asked what makes him feel good apart from alcohol he replies, "dancing".
